FX-TREMAP-001.says: Keys 0 at 0 and 11 at 11: t is n, as with no remap.

FX-TREMAP-002.says: Keys 0 at 0 and 11 at 6: twelve frames of source in six, then held on 11.

FX-TREMAP-003.says: Tutorial 1's burst then real speed: 0 at 0, 8 at 4, 16 at 12; two frames of source a frame, then one.

FX-TREMAP-004.says: One key, 5 at 3: every frame is source frame 5, a freeze.

FX-TREMAP-006.says: A hold key, 2 at 0, then 9 at 6: 2 until frame 6, then 9.

FX-TREMAP-007.says: Stretch 200, keys 0 at 0 and 8 at 4: the keys are read at u = n / 2, so t is n until u passes 4.

FX-TREMAP-008.says: Easy ease from 0 at 0 to 8 at 8: slow, fast, slow.

FX-TREMAP-009.says: In 3 and an offset of 5: the offset is not used, 0 at 3 and 6 at 9 give t = n - 3.

FX-TREMAP-030.says: 0 at 0 and 49 at 49: at frame 1 the straight line lands at 0.9999999999999999 in 64-bit numbers, within 1e-9 of 1, so t is 1 and the drawing is frame 1's.

FX-TREMAP-010.says: The drawings on twos with keys 0 at 0 and 5 at 5: red, red, blue, blue, green, green, as without a remap.

FX-TREMAP-011.says: One key, 2 at 0: frozen on source frame 2, blue, all six frames.

FX-TREMAP-012.says: A composition layer whose inner dot moves a pixel a frame, keys 0 at 0, 4 at 2 and 7 at 5: the dot moves two pixels a frame, then one, then stops at the inner composition's last frame.

FX-TREMAP-013.says: The same layer backwards, 7 at 0 and 0 at 7: the dot moves left.

FX-TREMAP-014.says: The drawings on twos slowed by keys 0 at 0 and 4 at 8, both frame blending switches on: frames 3 and 7 fall half way between two drawings and are half of each.

FX-TREMAP-015.says: The same with the layer's frame blending off: each source time rounds down, each drawing held four frames.

FX-TREMAP-016.says: Keys -2 at 0 and 10 at 12: before the inner composition starts and after it ends the layer is clear.

FX-TREMAP-017.says: Stretch 200 and keys 0 at 0 and 8 at 4: read at half the frame, the dot moves a pixel a frame as with no remap and no stretch.

FX-TREMAP-018.says: In 3, offset 5, keys 0 at 3 and 6 at 9: the offset is not used.

FX-TREMAP-019.says: Easy ease from 0 at 0 to 7 at 7: the dot starts slow and ends slow; each source time rounds down.

FX-TREMAP-040.says: In 0, out 12: keys 0 at 0 and 11 at 11.

FX-TREMAP-041.says: In 5, out 20, offset 3: keys 3 at 5 and 17 at 19.

FX-TREMAP-042.says: Stretch 200, in 0, out 12: the last frame's key time is 5.5, so keys 0 at 0 and 6 at 6.

FX-TREMAP-043.says: Stretch 50, in 0, out 6: keys 0 at 0 and 10 at 10.

FX-TREMAP-044.says: One frame long, in 4, out 5, offset 2: keys 2 at 4 and 3 at 5.

FX-TREMAP-045.says: No remap, freeze at 5: one hold key, 5 at 5.

FX-TREMAP-046.says: Stretch 200, no remap, freeze at 5: the key time 2.5 rounds to 3, holding the source time 2.5.

FX-TREMAP-047.says: Keys 0 at 0 and 11 at 6, freeze at 3: the keys are replaced by one, 5.5 at 3.

FX-TREMAP-048.says: Keys 0 at 0 and 11 at 6, the layer moved 2 frames later: the keys move to 2 and 8, the values stay.

FX-TREMAP-050.says: Time Remap on a solid layer, which has no source time.

FX-TREMAP-051.says: Time Remap on a null layer.

FX-TREMAP-052.says: Time Remap on an adjustment layer.

FX-TREMAP-053.says: A Time Remap key that is a pair of numbers.

FX-TREMAP-054.says: A Time Remap with an expression, which is not part of this.

FX-TREMAP-055.says: A Time Remap written as a bare number rather than a property.
